title: On Fine Girl Abroad: from a Master’s to a fully funded PhD in Italy
body: I joined Arike on her YouTube channel, **Fine Girl Abroad**, to talk about my experience in Italy: going from a Master's to a fully funded PhD, how the funding works, and my advice if you're planning the same move.
